project.name: host/pulumi-edge
project.description: The Pulumi external edge: the single host-side home for every contact with the Pulumi state backend and Automation API, mutualised across all domains. Holds the low-level StackHandle/StackHistory/StackSnapshot/StackCheckpoint over the file backend, and the implementations of the doctor ports both faces cross — StackHandleSnapshotSource (ingress, reads the timeline) and PulumiInterventionLedgerWriter (egress, writes the ledger). Non-playable (com.pulumi.* is native + ServiceLoader), so it stays in the host world; callers cross through the ports and never depend on this module directly.
